title: Muse Spark 1.1 adapter and benchmark for cheapest-correct-model evaluation
description: Build a bounded Meta Model API adapter and a reproducible cross-model benchmark packet to evaluate whether Muse Spark 1.1 should be rejected, used under bounded scope, or promoted with scope in the model-routing stack, based on correctness, safety, privacy, latency, reliability, and governance gates.
pain_point: The user lacks a standardized, reproducible evaluation workflow to verify that a candidate model meets all required gates (correctness, safety, privacy, latency, reliability, governance) before routing changes, risking silent paid-model fallback, security failures, or cost inefficiency if unvalidated vendor claims are trusted.
use_case: The user needs to construct a provider adapter and fixed benchmark packet covering MCP reliability, governed delegation, repository execution, long-context integrity, computer-use safety, and cost-adjusted correctness, using identical inputs, success criteria, and tool permissions across Muse and comparison lanes (GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra, Sol, Claude Fable 5, current promoted free/local lane) to produce a disposition of REJECTED, BOUNDED_USE, or PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE.

title: Keep latest HVAC review notes short and exact for AI tooling
description: Users need an inbox system that preserves the exact text of the most recent HVAC review notes, keeps them short enough for AI tools like ChatGPT or Codex to read fully, and retains attached context (page label, route, URL, viewport, user agent, priority, kind, visible context).
pain_point: If the inbox grows too long or truncates notes, the full text cannot be read by AI tools, and critical context (page label, route, URL, etc.) may be lost, hindering accurate review actions.
use_case: HVAC review workflow where an agent reads and acts on the latest note text; the inbox must store exact note text before any agent action, and before acting the agent quotes or summarizes the exact latest note text and its source page/route.

title: 提供第一方PDF查看器
description: 用户通过gipity sandbox运行一次性数据任务（CSV输入，PDF报告输出），代理生成PDF后需要视觉确认布局，但平台没有第一方命令来查看生成的PDF，导致代理必须手动运行pdftoppm栅格化为PNG，再通过Read查看，且每次修改后都需要重复该过程，增加了不必要的轮次和时间。
pain_point: No first-party way to look at a generated PDF，代理不得不hand-rolled：第二次沙箱调用运行pdftoppm -png -r 90栅格化页面，随后Read每个PNG；在修复图表后不得不重复整个栅格化和Read循环。
use_case: 通过gipity sandbox运行一次性数据任务，输入CSV销售数据，输出带月收入图表的PDF报告，代理在生成PDF后需要视觉确认布局才能完成任务。

title: 未发现AI工具需求
description: 讨论内容为Fable ↔ CLI自动运行日志的跟踪问题，未涉及任何AI工具相关需求。

title: 需要支持确定性步进游戏循环以验证物理/动画游戏
description: Gipity的`page eval`在验证实时canvas游戏时，因无法以确定性方式步进游戏循环，导致物理/动画验证失败。代理无法继续，只能放弃实时验证，使用静态截图，核心机制（砖块碰撞、得分、生命值）从未被验证。平台给出了警告但未提供解决方案。
pain_point: 无法确定性地步进游戏循环，导致实时验证失败；代理不得不放弃验证，核心游戏机制未经验证。
use_case: 代理使用`gipity page eval`驱动已部署的Phaser砖块破坏者游戏，尝试验证实时游戏循环（球弹跳、砖块破碎、得分增加、生命减少）。在第三次评估时，平台返回警告页面以14.5fps渲染，建议代理应“确定性地步进应用自己的循环”，但CLI或技能未提供步进游戏循环的方法。代理放弃实时验证，使用静态截图，核心机制从未被验证。
